headline: Ganesh Consumer Products submits investor presentation to the exchange
hook: Routine investor deck released by Ganesh Consumer
summary: Ganesh Consumer Products Limited has formally submitted its investor presentation to the stock exchange. headline: Ganesh Consumer Products announces interim dividend record date for November 9, 2026
summary: Ganesh Consumer Products Limited has notified the stock exchange that November 9, 2026, will be the record date for determining shareholders eligible for an interim dividend. Shareholders holding the stock as of this date will receive the payout. Retail investors holding shares prior to the record date qualify for the dividend.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders will receive the announced interim dividend payout.

headline: Ganesh Consumer Products declares interim dividend of Rs 3.70 per share
hook: Third payout this year for Ganesh holders
summary: The board of directors of Ganesh Consumer Products Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 3.70 per equity share at their meeting held on November 2, 2026. This payout provides direct cash returns to eligible shareholders on record. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this corporate action represents a steady stream of income alongside potential capital appreciation.
why_it_matters: Cash credited directly to eligible shareholders' bank accounts.
